title: Starting Jiu-Jitsu Over 40: It's Never Too Late
desc: Thinking you're too old for BJJ? Here's why adults over 40 on Cape Cod are thriving on the mats and how to start safely.

Starting Jiu-Jitsu Over 40: It's Never Too Late

October 4, 2026 · Cristyan BJJ Academy, Hyannis MA

Plenty of people start Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in their 40s, 50s, and beyond. If you're wondering whether it's too late, the answer is no.

Technique over athleticism

BJJ rewards smart positioning and patience. Older students often progress well because they train thoughtfully.

Train at your own pace

You can choose your training partners, skip intense rounds when needed, and focus on drilling. A good coach will help you train for the long term.

Health benefits that matter more with age

Mobility, balance, grip strength, and cardiovascular fitness all improve with consistent training.

Tips for starting safely

Check with your doctor if you have health concerns, warm up thoroughly, tap early, and prioritize recovery. Two or three classes a week is plenty to start.

You'll be in good company

Academies across the country, including ours in Hyannis, have students who started later in life and love it.

Cristyan Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Academy welcomes adults of every age from Hyannis, Barnstable, Dennis, and beyond.
